snippet.title: The Wake Event | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Awaken aboard an abandoned space station where the crew has vanished, the systems are failing, and something is watching.

In The Wake Event, explore eight interconnected modules, solve terminal-based puzzles, uncover the station's secrets, and make choices that determine your fate.

Available now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4757720/

Developed by Lickbeans Interactive.

#TheWakeEvent #IndieHorror #SciFiHorror
